setup_discriminative_reranking_task: setup a fairseq discriminative reranking NMT task with a data dictionary from a given data path
load_dataset_for_reranking: load a train valid or test dataset split for discriminative reranking with BLEU or TER labels
score_translations_with_reranker: score a batch of translation hypotheses using the RerankerScorer generate method with a single model
build_inference_dataset_for_reranking: build a dataset for inference from source tokens and lengths using TokenBlockDataset and ConcatSentencesDataset
reduce_metrics_for_bleu_ter: reduce logging outputs to compute BLEU or TER metrics during validation for discriminative reranking
